## About
Houston Automatic Transmission Service is family owned and operated. We work on transmissions and everything that gets power to your wheels: rebuilds, transfer cases, clutches, differentials, wheel bearings and all drive line services, foreign and domestic.
We serve Houston and the neighborhoods around us, including Spring, Cypress, Magnolia, The Woodlands, Tomball, Bear Creek, Copper Field and Jersey Village. We also offer fleet service for local companies and RV service.
Our customers rate us 4.6 from 77 reviews on Google. One reviewer put it simply: "Very trustworthy."

## Services
- Transmission repair and rebuilds: Transmission repair and full rebuilds.
- Transfer Cases: Transfer case repair and rebuilds.
- Clutches: Clutch repair and replacement.
- Differentials: Differential repair and service.
- Drive line services: Wheel bearings, axles, driveshafts, joints, mounts and the rest of the drive line.
- Fleet Service: Maintenance and repairs for company cars, trucks, SUVs and vans. We'll sit down with you first and build a maintenance program that fits your schedule.
- RV Service: Regular maintenance and big repairs for your RV, with the equipment and space to handle it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Do you offer any discounts?
A: We do. We offer discounts to military service members, senior citizens, teachers, commercial fleets and Hewlett Packard employees.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 18902 Highway 249, Houston, TX 77070, 1 mile north of FM 1960 W., between Grant and Cypresswood.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
